user_query: I am planning a family vacation and need information on available airplanes with Rolls-Royce engines. Additionally, I would like to know the current status of my orders and the list of products in the catalog.

TaskList.description: Search for available airplanes that have Rolls-Royce engines based on the travel destination and dates.
Fetch the current status of the user's orders to check any outstanding items related to the vacation.
Retrieve a list of products available in the catalog that may be useful for the vacation, such as travel accessories or services.
